## Change

Describe the user-visible problem and resulting behavior. Call out compatibility changes.

## Validation

List the relevant checks and their results. For image processing, include fidelity and CPU/HTTP/RAM evidence with its limits.

## Documentation

- [ ] Updated the relevant README, security or contributor guidance.
- [ ] Added notable changes to `CHANGELOG.md` under `Unreleased`.
- [ ] Ran `python3 scripts/project.py sync` and `check`.
- [ ] No personal data, secrets, private fixtures or machine paths are included.
